shell_commands: ls && cat package.json | head -60 && ls tools 2>/dev/null; ls scripts 2>/dev/null
grep -rn "const eventually\|delegatingTo\|const summaries\|const clients: WebSocket" src example smoke --include="*.ts" | grep -v node_modules

grep -rn "wsTestSupport" src --include="*.ts" | grep import; echo ---; grep -rn "stopEngines\|connectClient\|startEngineWith\|onlySession\|framesUntil\|askOnOpen\|announcedId\|deferred(" src --include="*.ts" | grep -v "wsTestSupport.ts" | head -40
grep -rn "useFakeTimers\|setSystemTime" src --include="*.ts" | head; echo ---; grep -n "listFor\|listFor?\|SessionListOptions\|SessionCursor\|SessionSummary" src/types/sessionStore.ts | head -20
grep -rn "client.terminate()\|wss.clients.size\|setTimeout(resolve, 10)" src scripts example smoke --include="*.ts" --include="*.mjs" | grep -v node_modules

npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/sessionList.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git diff --stat
grep -n "servers\|clients" src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | head; echo ---; git diff src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts

git add src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/sessionList.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
refactor(transport): pay down the eslint findings on the list frames

CI named 13 errors on e96d881: duplicated test helpers across the
sessionList, sessionResume and conversationList suites, a wrapped happy
path in the acceptance helper, a two-line comment in messageHandler, and
a switch plus nested ifs in the validator.

The duplicated helpers move to src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts, whose
stopEngines now waits for each server to see its sockets close before
stopping it - the drain both suites used to inline. validateMessage
dispatches through a table keyed by the wire name and reads limit and
before through flat guards. No assertion moved.

Refs #144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -2
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
